label: Golf Handicap Index
base_noun: golfers with an official Handicap Index
definition: A golfer's World Handicap System Handicap Index: the average of the best 8 of the last 20 score differentials, in strokes relative to course difficulty. Lower is better, and plus handicaps (written +2.0) are better than scratch (0.0) and stored as negative numbers.
phrasings: what is a top 1% golf handicap
how good is a single digit handicap
what handicap do the best amateur golfers have
activity_label: who hold an official golf Handicap Index
